title: CAT 2023 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Aptitude - Sequences and Series
subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.q: A lab experiment measures the number of organisms at 8 am every day. Starting with 2 organisms on the first day, the number of organisms on any day is equal to 3 more than twice the number on the previous day. If the number of organisms on the $n^{\text{th}}$ day exceeds one million, then the lowest possible value of $n$ is
questions.explain:
Let $x_n$ be the number of organisms on day $n$. The relation given is $x_1 = 2$ and $x_n = 2x_{n-1} + 3$. 
Adding 3 to both sides yields $x_n + 3 = 2(x_{n-1} + 3)$. This transforms the sequence into a geometric progression $y_n = 2 y_{n-1}$ where $y_n = x_n + 3$. 
The first term is $y_1 = x_1 + 3 = 2 + 3 = 5$. The general term is $y_n = 5 \times 2^{n-1}$. 
Thus, $x_n = 5 \times 2^{n-1} - 3$. 
We need $x_n > 1000000$, meaning $5 \times 2^{n-1} - 3 > 1000000 \implies 5 \times 2^{n-1} > 1000003 \implies 2^{n-1} > 200000.6$. 
Testing powers of 2: $2^{10} = 1024$, $2^{17} = 131072$, $2^{18} = 262144$. 
Since $2^{18}$ is the first power to exceed 200000.6, we have $n - 1 = 18 \implies n = 19$.
